notes:
- Local charts of accounts for 112 countries, in the local language; every other country uses the chart of the country it follows, in its own currency
- More ready-made transaction types: refund of an advance received or paid, owner draw returned, gift voucher sold and capital withdrawn
- New ready-made transaction types are added automatically when your country's chart is updated; your own types are never changed
- The chart of accounts and the advanced bookkeeping mode are available depending on your country
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
